# CommonMark emphasis fixtures

`commonmark-emphasis.json` selects the “Emphasis and strong emphasis” examples
from CommonMark version 0.31.2 (28 January 2024), by John MacFarlane.
Source: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json
Specification: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/

The specification and these derived examples are licensed under
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

The selection omits unrelated sections and metadata and labels three raw HTML
examples with Orbyn's explicit `inert_html` policy. Original Markdown and expected
CommonMark HTML remain present. Tests compare visible character emphasis and
verify literal, nonexecuting HTML under the separate Orbyn requirement.
